mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 3.5% compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production below 120 signals manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate output and earnings, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO remains below 120.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 3.5% signals monetary tightening that increases borrowing costs and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payrolls exceeding 130,000 thousand persons indicate labor market strength that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS exceeds 130,000.

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth rate below 2.0% annualized signals economic slowdown that reduces corporate profit outlook, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth rate remains below 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and GDP growth (GDPC1) indicate systemic economic slowdown that triggers negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both INDPRO and GDPC1 decline for two consecutive months.
